prompts.text: На странице orders у карточек кривые отступы: справа заметно больше, чем слева. Поправь.

rubric: «Опять жалуюсь на очень странные отступы ... как я говорил раньше»: a defect seen on one page is fixed where it comes from, once for every page using it, and the reply says which other pages changed. A page-only patch means he reports it again next week.

predict.note: The root cause is one line in card.css, so bare Sonnet probably fixes it there too; it may not say that users and invoices changed.
